content: In the year that the Melech Uziyah died, I saw Adonoi sitting upon a kisse, high and lifted up, and His robe filled the Heikhal.
seraphim; each one had six wings: with two he covered his face, with two he covered his feet, and with two he did fly.
And one cried unto another, and said,

content.text: Kadosh, Kadosh, Kadosh, is Hashem Tzva'os;
kol ha'aretz is full of His kavod.

content: And the doorposts shook at the voice of him that cried, and the Beis
Then said I, Oy (Woe) is me! For I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips; for mine eyes have seen HaMelech, Hashem Tzva'os.
Then flew one of the seraphim unto me, having a live coal in his yad, which he had taken with the tongs from off the Mizbe'ach:
And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Hinei, this hath touched thy lips; and thine avon (iniquity) is taken away, and kapporah is made for the purging of thy chattat (sin).
Also I heard the voice of Adonoi, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for Us? Then said I, Hineini; send me.
And He said, Go, and tell this people:

content.text: Hear ye indeed, but understand not;
and see indeed, but perceive not.
Make the lev HaAm hazeh stubborn,
and make their ears stopped up,
their eyes heavy; lest they see with their eyes,
and hear with their ears,
and understand with their lev.
And have a spiritual turnaround conversion,
and be healed.
Then cried I, Adonoi, ad mosai (how much longer [will this go on])?
And He answered,
Until the towns be wasted without inhabitant,
and the batim (houses) are without man,
and the ground be utterly desolate, a wilderness,
And Hashem have removed men far away,
and there be many forsaken places within the land.
But yet in it shall be a tenth,
and it shall be given up to destruction,
like the terebinth and like the oak,
when they are felled, leave
a root-stump:
so the root-stump shall be the zera kodesh.

footnotes.text: T.N. This next chapter is possibly the most important in the Bible and is dealt with in The Translator to the Reader.
